name: AlignTransition
desc: A subclass of AnimatedWidget, using an animator of type Alignment to allow child components to transition between two Alignment objects.

fields.name: widthFactor
fields.desc: If non-null, the child's width factor, see [Align.widthFactor].

fields.name: heightFactor
fields.desc: If non-null, the child's height factor, see [Align.heightFactor].

fields.name: child
fields.desc: The widget below this widget in the tree.
